name: Primer
fit: Developer tools and content-heavy product UI.
principles: Functional, accessible, and restrained. Color carries meaning. Interface chrome stays quiet so content leads.
color: Functional roles for foreground, background, border, accent, success, attention, danger, and done. Light, dark, and high-contrast themes share those names.
typography: System and monospace stacks for product and code. Roles for title, body, and caption.
spacing: A numeric space scale for padding, gap, and control height.
shape: Small radii. Many controls are lightly rounded or square.
elevation: Overlays use a shadow plus a border. Most surfaces are flat.
layout: Page, pane, and split layouts for tools. Responsive breakpoints for narrow viewports.
components: Buttons, forms, navigation, dialogs, and data lists, with a strong focus state.
themes: Light, dark, and high-contrast modes share the same role names.
adapt: Keep the functional color roles, the quiet chrome, and the focus treatment. Change the accent and type so it is not GitHub.
